items.headline: Stem changing verbs:
e -> ie, o -> ue
TBD
items.paragraph: Stem changing verbs deviate from the normal pattern of regular verbs. When stem changing verbs are conjugated, they have a vowel change in the last syllable of the stem
In many verbs, such as empezar (to begin), the stem vowel changes from e to ie. Note that the nosotros/as and vosotros/as forms don't have a stem change.
